style_prompt: Children's picture book, landscape 3:2, graphite pencil contours, soft watercolor and colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, natural grass green, pale sky blue and earthy brown; no text, logos or watermarks.
scene_prompt: Contemporary community courtyard. A warm, socially skilled adult organizer introduces a gardener carrying seedlings to a teacher holding a blank community garden model while another neighbor joins with a watering can. Exactly four adults; natural limbs, grips and ground contact.
alt: 社區活動的協調者熱情介紹園丁與老師認識，鄰居帶著澆水壺加入，眾人開始合作規劃花園。
